Dr. Rowe shows the couch stretch for quick lower back pain relief.

This easy exercise will focus on hitting many muscle groups that may cause lower back pain, including the hip flexors and quadratus lumborum (QL). 

Give it a try and leave a comment below to let us know how it works for you!
